# (api.myquran.com/v2/sholat/jadwal/<id>/<yyyy>/<mm>), the only year captured (2026). No second year
# exists yet for a forward split, so each place's own file is split by date, forward in time: the 13
# of the research round (365 days each) fit on Jan-Sep (273 days), test on Oct-Dec (92 days) — a
# better split than "no split at all", the only one profiles-tested.md ran. The five kota the weekly
# monitor first fetched on 28 Sep 2026 (Medan, Palembang, Semarang, Surabaya, Yogyakarta; 61 days each,
# Sep-Oct 2026, archive/tables/monitor/id-kemenag/<kota>-2026.txt) follow the same date rule: September
# fit, October test, as split copies beside the 13's files (the monitor's own file keeps growing).
# Their margins are their own two-month fit plus the allowance the 13 full years show (Kemenag.kt,
# TWO_MONTH_ALLOWANCE): a fit over one month alone was a minute early on a held-out October day.
# Checked at each kab/kota's own unit (lat/lon empty). The monitor's 28 Sep 2026 recaptures of the 13
# hold no day their files do not (identical on all 61 days), so they are not rows here.
